env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A lowered construct ends at the end of its last token, whatever follows
# it: a line comment, a block comment before a closer, or the lines of a
# function literal. The module runs natively, ejects, and the ejected
# module builds and runs with go and with go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272 and
# prints the same output.
cd m
logos run .
stdout '^7 5 8 42 6 9 10 11 100 s 4$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -o $WORK/upstream$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/upstream$GOEXE
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/exprboundary

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

type Item struct {
	Name string
	N    int?
}

func orSeven(x int?) int {
	return x ?? 7 // comment after a coalesce fallback
}

func orBlock(x int?) int {
	return (x ?? 8 /* block comment before the closer */)
}

func wrapReturn() int? {
	return 42 // comment after an option wrap in a return
}

func fallbackFunc() int {
	var f (func() int)?
	g := f ?? func() int {
		return 4
	}
	return g()
}

func main() {
	var a int? = 5 // comment after a declaration wrap
	var b int?
	b = 6 // comment after an assignment wrap
	it := Item{Name: "x", N: 9 /* block comment before the closer */}
	it2 := Item{
		Name: "y",
		N:    10, // comment after a field wrap
	}
	var c int? = 11 /* block comment before the end of the line */
	p := &100 // comment after an address of a literal
	q := &"s" /* block comment after an address of a literal */
	fmt.Println(orSeven(nil), orSeven(a), orBlock(nil), wrapReturn() ?? 0, b ?? 0, it.N ?? 0, it2.N ?? 0, c ?? 0, *p, *q, fallbackFunc())
}
